summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K comprising ten daily 'Transaction in Own Shares' RNS disclosures covering buybacks executed on the London Stock Exchange from 04 to 17 September 2026. Purchases ran through Goldman Sachs International under authority granted at the 8 May 2025 AGM, per instructions issued 17 February 2026. Daily volumes ranged from 15,000 to 41,143 ordinary shares, with average prices from roughly $155.40 to $160.18. Shares are to be cancelled, reducing issued capital to 147,768,574 ordinary shares excluding 5,431,782 held in treasury. Watch execution pace versus the prior buyback programme.
